findings.description: The new CONFIG_MDNS_TASK_STACK_SIZE=8192 in sdkconfig.product does not reach the build: the mDNS component Kconfig is not among the Kconfigs the build sources and no MDNS symbol at all is defined in the generated header, so mdns keeps its default 4096-byte task stack and the idle mdns overflow will recur.
findings.evidence: firmware/sdkconfig.product line 22 sets CONFIG_MDNS_TASK_STACK_SIZE=8192; searching firmware/build/config/sdkconfig.h, sdkconfig.cmake and sdkconfig.json for MDNS returns no match; firmware/build/kconfigs.in has no line sourcing firmware/managed_components/espressif__mdns/Kconfig; app_webui.cpp 259-269 calls mdns_init() unconditionally.
findings.failureScenario: Boot a fresh panel and leave it idle: mdns_init() creates the mdns task with its default 4096-byte stack, the configured 8192 never took effect, and 15-30 s later the panel aborts with a stack overflow in task mdns, the same failure report 053 recorded and report 054 claims to have fixed.
findings.suggestedChange: Verify in firmware/build/kconfigs.in and build/config/sdkconfig.h that the mdns Kconfig is sourced and MDNS_TASK_STACK_SIZE is present, or keep mDNS out of the boot path when it cannot be sized.

findings.description: The reboot-path stack overflow in sys_evt is neither fixed nor diagnosed: the writer kept the 8192 already in the image and states the cause is unknown, so a commissioned panel can still abort shortly after a restart.
findings.evidence: artifacts/053-functional_testing.json stability fails with a stack overflow in task sys_evt about 700 ms after the reboot; artifacts/054-code_writing.json records the value as unchanged; firmware/build/config/sdkconfig.h line 744 shows 8192.
findings.failureScenario: A commissioned panel is power-cycled: boot reaches MQTT initialized, the reboot Wi-Fi event storm runs on sys_evt, about 700 ms later the panel aborts before app_logic and the console, so the panel stays dark until the next reset.
findings.suggestedChange: Instrument rather than resize again: log uxTaskGetStackHighWaterMark for sys_evt and the Wi-Fi driver task after the first post-reboot association, or move the station start off esp_wifi_start, then re-test a restart out of a configured session twice.

findings.description: Standing deviation carried from earlier rounds: the factory reset is a 10 s hold of the single front button, not the spec SET+MODE combination.
findings.evidence: app_logic.cpp 375-376 registers COMBO_ARM_MS on handles[0]; on_set_arm arms the 10 s NVS wipe.
findings.failureScenario: A user resting a finger on the front button for 10 s wipes Wi-Fi, broker and the room table with no second button confirming intent.
findings.suggestedChange: Keep the spec SET+MODE combination or require a second confirmation inside the countdown.

adc_button_group handles[0]: click push-to-talk, double click dismiss, 1 s hold arms a 10 s factory reset

notes: CONFIG_ESP_SYSTEM_EVENT_TASK_STACK_SIZE is 8192 in build/config/sdkconfig.h line 744 and the mqtt_net queue dispatch works: the configured boot reaches the console.
No MDNS symbol exists in the generated sdkconfig.h and firmware/build/kconfigs.in does not source the mdns Kconfig, so the claimed CONFIG_MDNS_TASK_STACK_SIZE=8192 is not in the image.
app_mdnscfg (empty header, notes.txt, idf_component.yml pinning espressif/mdns ~1.11.3) is in the tree but does not bring the mdns Kconfig into the Kconfig evaluation.
The sys_evt overflow on the reboot path remains unexplained at 8 KB.
Standing spec deviations unchanged: plain-MQTT default broker, empty-payload TRV poll, single-button factory reset, three-number voice vocabulary.
